basic_details.job_title: SFAC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Manager and Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Small Farmers' Agri-Business Consortium (SFAC) has notified 2 vacancies for Manager (Finance) / Assistant Gr.I posts on a deputation basis for a period of three (3) years. Candidates can apply offline by sending the application by post through proper channel to the Managing Director, Small Farmers' Agri-Business Consortium, NCUI Auditorium Building, 5th Floor. The last date to submit applications is 6 November 2026, starting from 7 September 2026. content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications complete in all respects should be sent by post through proper channel clearly superscribed "Application for the post of in SFAC" to the following postal address: Managing Director, Small Farmers' Agri-Business Consortium, NCUI Auditorium Building, 5th Floor, 3, Siri Institutional Area, August Kranti Marg, Hauz Khas, New Delhi -110016

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Holding analogous post on regular basis; or with five years regular service in a post in the Pay Level-7/8 of 7th CPC (Rs.44900-142400/-) with minimum three (03) years experience in matters relating to finance, budgeting and accounts. Note: 5 years combined experience in Level-7 & 8 shall be considered. Holding analogous post on regular basis; or with five years regular service in a post in the Pay Level-4 of 7th CPC (Rs.25500-81100/-) or equivalent with minimum five (05) years experience in Office Administration/collection of data of agribusiness projects and working knowledge of computer applications/technology.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Bio-data (in duplicate) as in the proforma given (Annexure-I). Attested photocopies of APARs for the last five years 2019-20 to 2023-24 (attested by Competent Authority not below the rank of Under Secretary to Govt. of India). Vigilance clearance / Integrity Certificate / cadre clearance certificate. Statement giving details of major or minor penalties imposed on the officer, if any, during the last 10 years (Annexure-II). Self-attested copy of any govt. issued ID such as DL, Passport, Voter Id, or Aadhar. Self-attested photocopies of educational certificates and mark sheets starting with Secondary Education.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is carried out for appointment on a deputation basis through the scrutiny of applications routed through proper channel, accompanied by required APARs, vigilance clearance, integrity certificate, and penalty statements.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the offline application for SFAC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application by post is 6 November 2026, which is within 60 days of publication of the advertisement in the Employment News starting from 7 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the maximum age limit for appointment on deputation?
faq.answer: The maximum age-limit for appointment on deputation shall not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications for determining eligibility.

faq.question: Q3. What is the duration of the deputation period?
faq.answer: The period of deputation shall be three (3) years, including short term contract.

faq.question: Q4. What documents must be attached with the application regarding past performance and clearance?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach attested photocopies of APARs for the last five years (2019-20 to 2023-24) attested by an authority not below Under Secretary, along with vigilance clearance, integrity certificate, cadre clearance, and a statement of major or minor penalties imposed during the last 10 years.
